package.name: aav_pose_check
package.description: pose_check (Rust, rclrs), a challenger (TODO 210, pose_source:=ndt): NDT leads ekf_global's absolute pose and the GPS only checks it. It passes NDT's fits on while NDT is trusted, the GPS's only while NDT isn't and the GPS is; when they disagree it says which is wrong (NDT's score, the GPS's fix, spread and jumps); it seeds a lost NDT from AMCL or the GPS; and with neither trusted its status is ERROR, which the sensor watchdog turns into a stop. The logic is the pose-check-core crate, with no ROS.
